notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
